name: Malachi
overview: The book of Malachi, the last of the minor prophets, delivers a solemn message from God addressing the impiety of His people and priests, calling them to faithfulness and reverence. God affirms His love for Israel while confronting their unfaithfulness and corrupt worship practices, emphasizing that His name will be honored among the nations with pure offerings. The prophet also foretells the coming of the Messiah and His forerunner, highlighting both the coming judgments on the wicked and the consolations promised to the righteous. Throughout, Malachi challenges the community to genuine covenantal faith, warning against treachery and unfaithfulness.
